full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph shows a long bench inside a simple roadside shelter. The shelter fills most of the frame with dark vertical posts at the sides and a central mullion dividing two large pale rear panels. A continuous dark horizontal band runs across the back at bench height, making a spare geometric background. Near the center of the bench, a large light-colored dog sits upright with pointed ears and its front legs hanging down over the seat edge. Beside it, a smaller dark dog with similarly alert ears faces forward, its paws also reaching toward the front. A man in a dark coat and brimmed hat sits to their right, shoulders slightly hunched, hands gathered near his lap. He turns his head to look out of the shelter toward the right rather than at the camera. A dark bag rests at the far right end of the bench. The empty left half of the seat balances the compressed group on the right and emphasizes the ordinary pause of waiting. Below the bench, a narrow sidewalk and curb run horizontally across the frame; a strip of darker road occupies the bottom edge. No vehicle is visible, and the bright rear panels hold little location detail. Even daylight makes the pale dog and rear panels luminous, while the man, smaller dog, bag, and shelter frame form a compact dark cluster. Fine grain and moderate softness retain a candid photographic quality. The humor and tenderness come from how naturally the three sit side by side on the same bench, each distinct in posture but held together by the plain public shelter.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头照片拍下一座简朴路边候车亭里的长凳。候车亭占据画面大部，两侧是深色竖柱，中央一根窗棂把背后两块明亮面板分开。凳背高度有一道连续的深色横带，构成简省的几何背景。长凳中央附近，一只浅色大狗竖直坐着，耳朵尖立，前腿垂过座位边。旁边一只耳朵同样警觉的深色较小的狗面向前方，两只脚也伸向长凳前沿。男子坐在它们右侧，身穿深色外套、戴有檐帽，双肩微缩，双手合在膝附近。他把头转向候车亭右侧，望着外面，而不是看相机。深色袋子放在长凳最右端。左半边空着的座位平衡右侧压缩的群体，强调平常等候的片刻。凳下狭窄的人行道与路缘横穿画面，更深色的路面占据底边。没有车辆出现，背后明亮面板也不提供多少地点信息。均匀日光让浅色狗与背景面板发亮，男子、较小的狗、袋子和亭架则聚成紧凑的暗色团块。细颗粒与适度柔化保留抓拍摄影质感。画面的幽默和温柔来自三者如此自然地并排坐在同一张凳上，各有姿态，却被简朴公共候车亭连为一体。
style_prompt_en: Observational black-and-white street photography with a quiet visual joke found in ordinary public space. Use direct, nearly level framing and simple architectural lines—posts, panels, bench, curb—to organize the scene into clear horizontal and vertical bands. Human and animal forms can sit within that structure without formal posing, their contrasting silhouettes and spontaneous postures carrying the relationship. A broad pale background allows dark figures and objects to register sharply while retaining a modest range of gray in clothing, fur, and pavement. Leave some purposeful empty space beside the main group to make the placement feel discovered rather than crowded. Grain and slight optical softness support an unpolished print quality. The emotional tone is affectionate and lightly ironic, achieved through timing and juxtaposition rather than dramatic action or exaggerated expression.
style_prompt_zh: 观察性的黑白街头摄影在平凡公共空间中发现安静的视觉幽默。采用直接、近乎水平的取景，以柱、面板、长凳和路缘等简明建筑线条把场景组织成清晰的横竖带。人与动物形体自然坐在结构里，不需正式摆拍，它们对照的剪影和自发姿态承担关系。宽阔浅色背景让深色人物与物件清楚显出，同时让衣物、皮毛和路面保留适度灰阶。主体群一侧留下有意的空位，使安排像偶然发现而非拥挤堆放。颗粒与轻微光学柔化支持未经修饰的相纸质感。情绪亲切、略带反讽，来自时机与并置，而非戏剧动作或夸张表情。
theme_en: A monochrome street photograph of a seated man and two dogs waiting inside a bare roadside shelter
theme_zh: 黑白街头照片中，一名男子与两只狗坐在简朴的路边候车亭里等待
name: Elliott Erwitt
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
